title: Are Mortgage Trigger Leads Illegal? Who Can Still Buy Them
meta_description: No. Since March 2026 a bureau may sell a mortgage trigger lead only to the borrower’s lender, servicer or bank, or with consent. GAO puts past payoff at 3.5%.

image.takeaway: Since March 2026 only the borrower’s lender, servicer, bank or an authorized buyer may buy a mortgage trigger lead.
image.alt: Mortgage trigger leads after the Homebuyers Privacy Protection Act: since March 2026 a credit bureau may sell one only to the originator or servicer of the borrower’s current mortgage, a bank or credit union holding the borrower’s account, or a buyer with the borrower’s authorization
